name: Julia Brim-Edwards

positions.statement: On her campaign site, Brim-Edwards cites her record on reducing unsheltered homelessness, increasing access to housing and ending street encampments.
positions.excerpt: reducing unsheltered homelessness, increasing access to housing, ending street encampments

positions.statement: On her campaign site, Brim-Edwards cites championing the effort to build a new 24/7 sobering center among her accomplishments.
positions.excerpt: championing the effort to construct a new 24/7 sobering center

positions.statement: On her campaign site, Brim-Edwards cites protecting the county's school-based mental health program from cuts as part of her record.
positions.excerpt: protecting the county’s school-based mental health program from cuts last year.

positions.statement: On her campaign site, Brim-Edwards says she will fight back against attacks on healthcare, food assistance, fair elections, local jobs and immigrant neighbors.
positions.excerpt: fight back against the attacks on healthcare, food assistance, fair elections, local jobs, and our immigrant neighbors.

positions.statement: On her campaign site, Brim-Edwards says she will work with labor and business for more good jobs with benefits.
positions.excerpt: I will work with labor and business for more good jobs with benefits so we can all thrive.

positions.statement: On her campaign site, Brim-Edwards describes pushing for more accountability and transparency in how government operates.
positions.excerpt: pushing for more accountability and transparency in how the government operates.

positions.statement: On her campaign site, Brim-Edwards describes the context for her campaign as life's basics being more expensive and a struggling local economy.
positions.excerpt: With life’s basics more expensive and a struggling local economy,

positions.statement: In a September 2025 county news release, Brim-Edwards said the Board's ordinance extends the existing ban on guns in public buildings to licensed concealed firearms.
positions.excerpt: This will extend the prohibition to licensed concealed firearms.

positions.statement: In an August 29, 2025 letter to the Legislature's transportation funding committee supporting HB 3991, Brim-Edwards wrote that without additional and stable revenue, county roads will deteriorate.
positions.excerpt: Without additional and stable revenue, Multnomah County roads will deteriorate and become more dangerous.

source.publisher: Office of Commissioner Julia Brim-Edwards, Multnomah County (letter)

positions.statement: Willamette Week reported in October 2026 that Basic Rights Oregon rescinded its endorsement of Brim-Edwards over alleged statements as a school board member; she disputed this, saying the idea she is anti-trans is a lie.
positions.excerpt: The idea that I'm anti-trans in any way is an out-and-out lie.

positions.statement: At a November 2024 county Veterans Day proclamation, Brim-Edwards spotlighted her chief of staff, a member of the Oregon Army National Guard, saying he has been a voice for veterans.
positions.excerpt: He has been a voice for veterans.
